name: Safe Harbor Marathon Marina & RV Resort
note: A gravel RV lot of about nine spaces beside the pool at a full-service marina. Motorhomes use the four waterfront spaces and space 9; spaces 5-8 are for towables only. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator page safeharbor.com/locations/safe-harbor-marathon (read 2026-10-30): 'RV Sites' section with phone 305-743-6575 and a Book Now link to its FareHarbor engine (shmarinas-marathon, flow 880422), which sells 'Waterfront RV Space Rentals' (Class A or C only) and 'Non-Waterfront RV Space Rentals' (spaces 5-8 towables, space 9 Class A/C), 1-30 nights with no minimum, and quoted one night on Tue Dec 8 2026 ($300 waterfront, $250 non-waterfront) with no application or approval. The operator's own site map and photos show motorcoaches on the seawall lot; Google Maps shows it open, 4.5/303, phone matches; RV Life lists 8 sites. Real transient RV lot; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's park map puts the 'RV Resort' block on the seawall at the north end of the property beside the pool, and its photos show motorcoaches nosed toward a seawall with a low rail and lawn in front of them. The 'Waterfront RV Space' booking type only triggered the audit. Esri satellite (sat.py, rendered: 3 km frame, 500 m frame at 24.7052,-81.1120, and a 140 m frame at 24.70600,-81.11265 with an enlarged crop of the seawall corner) shows the gravel RV lot directly behind a straight seawall on its west side. The water there is the open shallow bay between Knights Key and Marathon, about 700 m across and opening south to Boot Key Channel and the Atlantic; it is not a canal or a boat basin. Between the pad ends and the seawall there are only small open lawns and the seawall walk, about 10-18 m from rig to water, with no treeline, road or parking. The pool and the boat basin lie to the south and are not part of the call. Non-waterfront spaces 5-9 sit farther back in the lot; the value rests on the four waterfront motorhome spaces.
fees_source: FareHarbor engine fareharbor.com/embeds/book/shmarinas-marathon (items 425925 non-waterfront, 425919 waterfront), read 2026-10-30, 1 night Tue Dec 8 2026: Non-Waterfront (space 9 takes Class A/C) $250 subtotal + $46.25 taxes & fees = $296.25; Waterfront (Class A or C only) $300 + $55.50 = $355.50. The pricing sheet shows taxes of 7.5% + 5% (12.5%); the remaining 6% is FareHarbor's own online-booking fee, not a park fee. Summer is cheaper: Tue Jun 8 2027 Non-Waterfront $100, Waterfront $125.
flags: Cheapest in-season night a 23-ft Class C fits is $250 before tax (non-waterfront space 9, Tue Dec 8 2026); waterfront is $300. Summer drops to $100 / $125 (Jun 8 2027). Online bookings add FareHarbor's 6% booking fee on top of 12.5% tax. No resort fee was quoted.

January-March 2027 shows sold out online ('call to book') on both RV types, and April 2027 had no dates loaded yet on 2026-10-30. November-December 2026 and May-September 2027 were bookable online by the night. Policy: up to 30 nights online and at most 90 days a season. Monthly stays start only on the 1st or 15th and are booked by phone. No standing minimum.

Rig rules: waterfront spaces are 'for Class A or C RVs only'. Non-waterfront spaces 5-8 take only 5th wheel, pull-behind and travel trailers; space 9 is Class A or C. So a 23-ft Class C motorhome fits five spaces: the waterfront ones plus space 9. FareHarbor's text says '8 spaces total', but the space numbers run to 9; RV Life lists 8. Guests must be 21+.

Owner: Safe Harbor Marinas (bought the former Marathon Marina & RV Resort in 2021). It is a marina first, with boat slips, a boatyard, a restaurant and three vacation-rental units (7-night minimum for those), but the RV lot is a separate, online-bookable product. Not in the Good Sam directory. Not a Sun, Thousand Trails, condo or membership park.

Google: the marina listing (the one the booking engine cites) is 4.5/303. A separate Google listing, 'Safe Harbor Marathon Marina & RV Resort' at 725 11th Street Ocean, is 4.5/16 and links the old marathonmarinaresort.com, which now redirects to the Safe Harbor page.
RV Life: 5 stars (10/10) from 6 reviews, $$$$ tier, avg_rate $185, 8 sites. The candidate record had stars null.
